note_en: 了 right after a verb marks a completed action or result, not past tense as such: 它只是通过大量数据学会了怎么回答 "it has simply learned how to respond." Notice the negative at the end of the story: 永远学不会 "will never learn," where 不 slips between 学 and the result complement 会 to say the result can't be achieved.
